tool_args.rationale: The pilot suggests sink inhibition, while the acquired horizons show slow sign reversal. A sink-modulated baseline plus a saturating slow adaptation term combines these effects in five numerically fitted parameters; fresh confirmation will test the hypothesis.

considered_alternatives.option: Pure dual-exponential adaptation without sink coupling
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short-horizon observations show substantial sink-gradient dependence, which that model does not represent.
The long-horizon observations reverse sign, incompatible with a stationary positive siphon alone.
The acquired long-horizon rows provide eight observations spanning the forecast regime; first test the five-parameter coupled hypothesis.
It is not informative about the target mechanism.
